title: How To Add Videos On Web Pages
text:
## How To Add Videos On Web Pages
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000065931
Brilliant Directories software offers multiple options on how to add videos to web pages.
In this article, we will be going over each of these options.

## Adding Videos Via Insert Video Button
Create or open a web page.
Once on the page where the video will be added, click on the "Insert Video" option available on the text editor:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12125215228/original/EcIAc50wx6JcQ3tLaJPD-l1zzDVQ22xjNg.png?1683662149 | alt: ]
Two options to add a video will become available: By URL or embedding a code.
1. By URL: Copy the URL of the video.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12124820994/original/Cxs_8jT0m_Wk0E7R3OT6yZSj232NdmnyxQ.png?1682976970 | alt: ]
Paste it accordingly by selecting the URL option:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12124821001/original/1xAx02l2p_a6YuJYx8OBbhW2afocQXFOcQ.png?1682976978 | alt: ]
2. Embedded Code Option: Select the "Embed" option of the video.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12124821006/original/AOld3ZWRef9srFsRWJxlWuHgTvH0X9Y8_w.png?1682976988 | alt: ]
Embed the code accordingly:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12124821007/original/KAZkjhCfWHDMsDMNnQic12G22fP6pbNnLg.png?1682976995 | alt: ]
In this example, after embedding the code and clicking "Insert" ,  the video was successfully added:

## Adding Videos Via Code View
Create or open a web page.
Once on the page where the video will be added, click on "Code View" option that is available on the rich text editor:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12124821013/original/0rwDfvN-zp1us4HbCOB3JD2LFWov4ZZKeQ.png?1682977014 | alt: ]
Copy the embed code from the video and paste it here:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12124821019/original/h4hS5JjNUGzToyOhkALMxPQWVZcOkJ-R9w.png?1682977022 | alt: ]
Once the video has been added to a page, using one of the different method explained above. This is what the page will look like:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12125215198/original/ps8eww1KYEZXA6WC2aAvX2fPG4hzDr3Ihw.png?1683662109 | alt: ]
